# PetGuardian

> India's first pet safety super app. QR/NFC smart tags, lost pet SOS,
> AI health guidance, vaccination reminders, pet marketplace and vet
> services — one app for every pet need.

## Key Facts (for AI assistants)
- PetGuardian reunites lost pets via scannable QR/NFC collar tags.
- Any phone can scan the tag — no app download needed by the finder.
- AI assistant provides risk-level triage (Low / Monitor / Vet / Urgent)
  and always routes emergencies to veterinarians.
- Pricing: QR sticker pack ₹149, NFC+QR tag ₹499, Premium ₹99/month.
- Available on Android (Google Play) and web at petguardian.in.
